outcome.answer: R2LM in Bifocal Diffusion Language Models is designed to improve throughput by combining causal attention with a lightweight reverse Mamba sidecar, while keeping KV caching compatible [1]. The paper reports 2.4× to 12.9× higher throughput than bidirectional diffusion LMs and 1.9× to 2.9× speedup over autoregressive baselines in batch serving with parallel decoding and KV caching [1].
